spain-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 11% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Spain 2024 REE wind curtailment: ~6.8 TWh/yr per REE Informe del Sistema Eléctrico 2024.

spain-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 5.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Spain 2024 REE PV curtailment: ~2.4 TWh/yr + 1.4 TWh CSP per REE Informe 2024.

portugal-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 3% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Portugal 2024 wind: ~0.1 TWh/yr anchor.

portugal-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 10% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Portugal 2024 solar: primary per REN/ENTSO-E.

germany-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B18 × 17.8% + wind B19 × 3% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Germany 2024 BNetzA/SMARD: 4.56 TWh offshore wind + 3.38 TWh onshore wind curtailed.

germany-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2.3% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Germany 2024 BNetzA/SMARD solar: 1.39 TWh curtailed.

finland-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 5% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Finland 2024 wind: ENTSO-E A75 FI bidding zone B19.

finland-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 1% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Finland 2024 solar: ENTSO-E A75 FI bidding zone B16; very small at high latitude.

netherlands-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B18 × 4.9% + wind B19 × 4.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Netherlands 2024 IEEFA: 3.0 TWh wind+solar curtailment, wind-dominant share.

netherlands-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 4.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Netherlands 2024 IEEFA solar share of 3.0 TWh total.

poland-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Poland 2024 URE wind curtailment: regional default ~2%.

poland-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 1% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Poland 2024 URE solar curtailment: regional default ~1%.

greece-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 3% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Greece 2024 IPTO wind curtailment: regional default ~3%.

greece-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Greece 2024 IPTO solar curtailment: regional default ~2%.

romania-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Romania 2024 Transelectrica wind: regional default ~2%.

romania-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 1.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Romania 2024 Transelectrica solar: regional default ~1.5%.

italy-north-zone-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 0.30% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). ENTSO-E North Italy: ~35% of Terna 2024 national curtailment, wind share.

italy-north-zone-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 0.60% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). ENTSO-E North Italy: ~35% of Terna 2024 national curtailment, solar share.

italy-sicily-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 3.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). ENTSO-E Sicily: island HVDC constraint; wind-dominant.

italy-sicily-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 4% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). ENTSO-E Sicily: island HVDC constraint; significant solar.

italy-sardinia-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). ENTSO-E Sardinia: island HVDC constraint; wind share.

italy-sardinia-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 4.7% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). ENTSO-E Sardinia: island HVDC constraint; solar-dominant share.

sweden-north.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 1% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). ENTSO-E SE2 wind-only calibration; solar negligible in SE2.

sweden-south-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). ENTSO-E SE4 wind: regional default ~2%.

sweden-south-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 7% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). ENTSO-E SE4 solar: PV-heavy per SE4 grid characteristics.

hungary-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 1% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). MAVIR 2024: wind secondary, regional default ~1%.

hungary-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 3% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). MAVIR 2024: solar dominant.

czech-republic-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 1% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). CEPS 2024: wind secondary, regional default ~1%.

czech-republic-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). CEPS 2024: solar dominant.

bulgaria-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 1.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). ESO Bulgaria 2024: wind share.

bulgaria-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). ESO Bulgaria 2024: solar share.

switzerland.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 1.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Swissgrid PV-only ENTSO-E feed; wind negligible and hydro spill not in A75. Models summer-midday PV oversupply only; understates total Swiss curtailment.

serbia-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 3% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). EMS Serbia ENTSO-E A75 wind: regional default ~3%.

serbia-solar.sourceNote: EMS Serbia ENTSO-E A75 solar: regional default ~2%.

bosnia-and-herzegovina.sourceNote: BH Krajina A75 feed; hydro-dominated system. Structural hydro spill excluded per methodology.

north-macedonia-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 3% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). MEPSO North Macedonia: regional default ~3% wind.

north-macedonia-solar.sourceNote: MEPSO North Macedonia: regional default ~2% solar.

montenegro.sourceNote: CGES Montenegro A75 feed; hydro-dominated system. Structural hydro spill excluded per methodology.

croatia-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). HOPS Croatia ENTSO-E A75 wind: regional default ~2.5%.

croatia-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). HOPS Croatia ENTSO-E A75 solar: regional default ~2%.

slovenia-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). ELES Slovenia ENTSO-E A75 wind: regional default ~2%.

slovenia-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). ELES Slovenia ENTSO-E A75 solar: regional default ~2%.

slovakia-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). SEPS Slovakia ENTSO-E A75 wind: regional default ~2%.

slovakia-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). SEPS Slovakia ENTSO-E A75 solar: regional default ~2.5%.

lithuania.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Litgrid Lithuania ENTSO-E A75 feed. Wind 2.5% rate anchored to Litgrid published 2024 wind curtailment.

latvia.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). AST Latvia ENTSO-E A75 feed. Wind 2.5% regional default.

estonia.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2.5% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Elering Estonia ENTSO-E A75 feed. Wind 2.5% regional default.

luxembourg-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Cegedel Luxembourg ENTSO-E A75 wind: regional default ~2%.

luxembourg-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Cegedel Luxembourg ENTSO-E A75 solar: regional default ~2%.

moldova-wind.sourceNote: ENTSO-E wind B19 × 3% calibrated (observed 30d split: wind 100%). Moldelectrica ENTSO-E A75 wind: regional default ~3%.

moldova-solar.sourceNote: ENTSO-E solar B16 × 2% calibrated (observed 30d split: solar 100%). Moldelectrica ENTSO-E A75 solar: regional default ~2%.

malta.sourceNote: Enemalta ENTSO-E A75 solar: regional default ~2% (PV-dominant island grid).
